<!-- poster -->

## The same component, in two languages {visibility="uncounted"}

| | `primarycensored`, R and Stan | `CensoredDistributions.jl` |
|---|---|---|
| Adding a distribution | New branch, new integer, rebuild | Pass the type |
| Distributions covered | 18, listed in a switch | Any univariate one |
| Choosing one | An integer, set before sampling | The object itself |
| Sharing the code | Splice 1,103 Stan lines in at build | `Project.toml` |
| The integral | `integrate_1d`, then an ODE recast | 64 fixed nodes |
| Worst failure | 243 of 256 chains died | 8 scenarios broken on one backend |

::: {.callout-important}
The Stan file has to know every distribution it will ever support. The
Julia file does not have to know any of them.
:::

## What the move fixed, and what it did not {visibility="uncounted"}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}
**Removed**

::: {.bignum}
0
:::

::: {.bignum-label}
tables left to keep in step
:::

A class of bug. `dist_id = 3` meant Normal in Stan and Weibull in R, so
asking for a Weibull fitted a normal and returned numbers. The two
integer tables agreed on lognormal, gamma and exponential, and on
nothing else.

`primary_censored(Weibull(2, 1), Uniform(0, 1))` carries the type. There
is no second table for it to disagree with.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
**Moved**

::: {.bignum}
4 of 6
:::

::: {.bignum-label}
autodiff backends carry a broken scenario
:::

The numerical problem, from the language to the autodiff backends. Six
backends run in CI, each with its own workflow. Two pass every
scenario, four carry scenarios registered broken, out of 63.

The default solver is `GaussLegendre(; n = 64)` because fixed nodes
trace through every backend. Stan gave up adaptive quadrature for an
ODE, Julia for a dot product.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
**Unchanged**

::: {.bignum}
100×
:::

::: {.bignum-label}
more downloads in R, all time
:::

Who uses it. 11,294 downloads all time against 122, and 538 last month
against 6.

Nine GitHub repositories depend on `primarycensored`, two of them on
CRAN. Seven are mine, two are CDC's. Everything depending on
`CensoredDistributions.jl` is mine, Sam Brand's or Sebastian Funk's.

Twenty-one months on CRAN against twelve in General, so the gap is not
all the package.
:::
